Now I need to prove `UnitCoherence`. The statement:

```lean
def UnitCoherence (S : Iut.SchemeOverField F)
    (G : Iut.EtaleStackPseudofunctor F) : Prop :=
  ∀ (eta : Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans (Y S) G)
    {a b : LocallyDiscrete (Iut.SchemeOverField F)ᵒᵖ} (f : a ⟶ b),
    (Y S).map f ◁ (unitNat G eta b).hom ≫ ((ofObjFull G (toObj G eta)).naturality f).hom =
      (eta.naturality f).hom ≫ (unitNat G eta a).hom ▷ G.map f
```

where `ofObjFull G x = ofObj G x (idCoherence G x) (compCoherence G x)`, so `(ofObjFull G (toObj G eta)).naturality f = ofNat G (toObj G eta) f = Cat.Hom.isoMk (Discrete.natIso (fun P => (Cat.Hom.toNatIso (G.mapComp (Quiver.Hom.toLoc P.as.op) f)).app x))`.

at P : Discrete (b.as.unop ⟶ S):
